desc:
✈️ Start on an empty field, build your runway and watch your first plane land on it. Every plane pays you!
🏗️ Pad by pad, grow a real airport that keeps earning even while you're offline.

HOW TO PLAY
🟢 Step on green pads to build: runway, café, check-in, terminal…
💵 Planes drop cash on your runway: grab it!
✨ Watch for the Golden Jet: it pays big!
👷 Hire managers: they work while you're away
📞 Answer charter calls for big deals
🚨 RUSH HOUR: the sky turns gold and ALL income is ×3!

🌍 Pick your country: its flag flies over your airport (country liveries in the shop)
🗺️ Later: from Palm Island to Desert Oasis, Snow Peak and Volcano Island

👫 4 airports per server: visit your friends' airports and like them!
